ordinal_invariant.basis: EBX=R10D=RDI=0 before carve; R8=kind table row0
ordinal_invariant.inner: For row k with count c[k], exactly c[k] iterations: old EBX is pointer slot; EBX++, stamp low5=k/top3=table[k].kind; advance by rounded size; R11-- until0.
ordinal_invariant.outer: After row k, EBX=S[k+1], R10D=k+1, RDI=2(k+1), R8=table+4(k+1). Zero-count row skips inner and still increments k; S[k]=sum(c[:k]).
ordinal_invariant.consequence: Ordinal i in [S[k],S[k+1]) maps to carve rowk. Initializer gets same pool, i; RBX=pool[1+i]; directory=desc+signedDWORD18+4+48*i for version>=8 (32*i for older).
